Setup.Name: Use regular expression
Setup.Description: A simple example on how to parse a text paylog using regular expressions to create detailed metrics manually.
Setup.Manifest:
Version: 1.0

MqttConnections:
  - Name: "My broker"

OtelConnections:
  - Name: "My Otel server"
    ServiceName: "my-service"
    ServiceNamespace: "my-service-namespace"

Processors:
  - Name: "Processor Temperature"
    Description: "Provides the current processor temperature."
    Mqtt: 
      Subscriptions:
        - Name: "Processor information"
          Topic: "message-topic"
    Otel:
      Metrics:
        - Name: "Processor.Temperature"
          Description: "The current processor temperature."
          SignalDataType: Float
          Instrument: Gauge
          Attributes:
            - Key: "test"
              Value: "value"
          Value: "REGEX('Temperature: ([0-9]*)')"
